summary.content:
Today's selection covers 78 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 50 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: A Humble 3-Wheel Electric Vehicle Lands Toyota in Federal Court
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: New Prinz Eugen ransomware prioritizes recent files for encryption
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, BBC Technology, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 10 articles published in the last 24 hours
